objective: Prevent over-investment in a single transcript. Discover and queue broad game coverage before deep per-quest evidence annotation.

phases.name: inventory
phases.action: Discover transcript/storyline index and quest pages across every supported game.

phases.name: classify
phases.action: Route each page to dialogue, books, developer material, or provenance-only.

phases.name: local_fetch
phases.action: Fetch full dialogue bodies locally and hash/cache them.

phases.name: structure
phases.action: Parse speakers, prompts, scenes, quests and sequence.

phases.name: enrich
phases.action: Add subjects, claims, contradictions and cross-source links only after broad ingestion coverage exists.

guardrails: Do not spend more than one enrichment pass on a transcript while another game's transcript inventory remains undiscovered.
Prefer adding 20 newly discovered transcript pages over adding more topic tags to one already-structured quest.
Per-quest hand annotation is fallback/validation data, not the primary scaling strategy.
Crawl state reports inventory coverage separately from enrichment depth.
